TINA-SOURCED 4 Aug 2026 · ONE DERIVED FIGURE CARRIED BY TWO KEYS. DERIVATION: PRB 230g R50 -> R217/kg; Fu Chi 400g R70-R95 -> R175-R238/kg. Band R175-R238, TOP OF THE BAND per the most-expensive rule (Tina 13 Jun). ⚖️ `doubanjiang` AND `chilli bean paste` ARE THE SAME PRODUCT and both carry R238. ⛔ NEITHER KEY IS DELETED — same shape and same remedy as the three mushroom keys (4 Aug). The alias `doubanjiang` -> `chilli bean paste` is INERT by design (the exact-key rung runs before the alias rung), so the pair must be kept in step BY HAND. 🩸 WHY R413 WAS WRONG: the 30 Jul working paired the DEAREST price with the SMALLEST jar — R95 / 230g = R413/kg — but R95 is the 400g jar. Correctly paired it is R50/230g = R217/kg and R95/400g = R238/kg. The 30 Jul comment also read "R269/kg" beside a value of 413; A KEY WHOSE COMMENT CONTRADICTS ITS OWN VALUE IS UNUSABLE AS EVIDENCE, so neither number survived on its own authority and the figure was re-derived from the source range. ⚠️ CORRECTION TO THE 4 AUG ENTRY BELOW, WRITTEN RATHER THAN QUIETLY DROPPED: that entry stated "zero lines currently use `doubanjiang`". THAT IS FALSE AND IS STRUCK. The claim came from a chilli-vocabulary audit whose pattern never contained the word "doubanjiang", so the probe could only ever return zero — it measured nothing. MEASURED PROPERLY 4 Aug: 9 ingredient lines use it (china-mapo-tofu, china-yu-xiang-qie-zi, china-hui-guo-rou, china-staple-master-stock, china-mala-xiang-guo, china-da-pan-ji, china-chongqing-huo-guo), and the R413->R238 move shifted 13 version costs — 5 scoreable, 8 already-UNSCOREABLE. THE LESSON IS THE ONE THE REPO KEEPS PAYING FOR: a probe that cannot return a positive is not evidence of absence. THIS KEY: added 4 Aug 2026. Corrects 3 lines (china-mapo-tofu, china-yu-xiang-qie-zi, netherlands-rijsttafel) that were resolving to `chilli` R80 through a §3j substring fallthrough — a fermented bean paste priced as fresh chilli, roughly 3x under.
